Dear Client Contact,
Welcome to Insperity from the Reporting & Compliance Group of Insperitys Health and Welfare Services department. Our group assists Insperity clients with compliance in regards to the Play or Pay provisions of the Affordable Care Act (ACA).
The attached document ACA (Play or Pay) for Insperity Clients will help explain these provisions and how Insperity complies with them in regards to Insperity-sponsored benefit plans.
ACA Information Verification: Action Required
As part of our efforts to assist you, our Reporting & Compliance Group would like to confirm certain employer information for your company, and request additional information as well. Please reply to this email to provide confirmation, additional information, or make corrections to the information below to ensure ACA employer and employee calculations are accurate.
For a brief description of the below terminology please see the attached document ACA Definitions Quick Reference Guide for Insperity Clients .
" <Insert ALE table here.> "
Predecessor Hours Request:
Insperity records show that all of your employees since joining Insperity are full-time. If you confirm this, Insperity will use its selected default for full-time employees (8 hours per day, 5 days a week) when calculating your companys ALE status and employee hours. However, if any of your employees were NOT full-time prior to joining Insperity, Insperity will be happy to use the hours you provide for those employees for its calculations.
Thank you for your prompt attention to this time sensitive matter.
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at ale@insperity.com .
Kind Regards,
<insert signature>
